recipes.name: 玉米紅蘿蔔排骨湯（壓力鍋）

prepNotes.en: EPC17: 1) Blanch ribs 3–5 min, rinse. 2) Bowl in → ribs + corn + carrot + ginger (+ dates) + water (under MAX). 3) Valve down, lock. 4) Pressure cook HI-P ~30–35 min. 5) Natural release ≥5 min, then open safely. 6) Salt to taste. Soft meat+veg soup for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: 1) Blanch ribs 3–5 min, banlawan. 2) Bowl → ribs + corn + carrot + ginger (+ dates) + tubig (under MAX). 3) Valve down, lock. 4) Pressure HI-P ~30–35 min. 5) Natural release ≥5 min, tapos buksan nang safe. 6) Asin sa dulo. Soft soup para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：1) 排骨飛水 3–5 分鐘沖淨。2) 內鍋放排骨＋玉米＋紅蘿蔔＋薑（可加紅棗）＋水（勿超 MAX）。3) 閥按下、鎖蓋。4) 高壓 HI-P 約 30–35 分鐘。5) 自然洩壓≥5 分鐘再開蓋。6) 最後加鹽。湯軟適合 Zizi。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Blanch ribs → bowl + ribs + ginger + water → HI-P 20 min. Quick-release carefully OR natural 5 min. Add winter melon (+ goji) → Pressure LO-P or Steam 8–10 min until soft. Salt. Don’t overcook melon to mush if Zizi prefers cubes.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Blanch ribs → bowl + ribs + ginger + tubig → HI-P 20 min. Release nang safe. Lagyan winter melon (+ goji) → LO-P/Steam 8–10 min hanggang malambot. Asin. Huwag sobrang luto kung gusto ni Zizi may cubes.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：排骨飛水 → 內鍋＋排骨＋薑＋水 → HI-P 20 分鐘。安全洩壓。加冬瓜（可加枸杞）→ LO-P／蒸 8–10 分鐘至軟。加鹽。若 Zizi 要有塊感勿煮太爛。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Optional Brown mode (lid often open) — sear beef/onion. Add tomato, potato, seasonings + liquid under MAX. Lock → Pressure HI-P ~25–30 min. Natural release 10 min. Soft enough for Zizi; cut smaller if needed. Serve with rice (rice cooker).
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Optional Brown (madalas bukas ang lid) — sear beef/onion. Lagyan tomato, potato, seasonings + liquid under MAX. Lock → HI-P ~25–30 min. Natural release 10 min. Malambot para kay Zizi. Serve with rice.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：可用煎香模式（多數開蓋）略煎牛肉／洋蔥。加番茄、薯仔、調味＋液體（勿超 MAX）。鎖蓋 → HI-P 約 25–30 分鐘。自然洩壓 10 分鐘。軟嫩適合 Zizi；配飯煲白飯。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Bowl → chicken + ginger/onion + soy + sugar + water. Valve down, lock. Pressure HI-P ~15–18 min (bone-in). Natural release 5–10 min. Sauce can reduce on Brown/simmer lid-open if Sir/Mum showed. Remove bones for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Bowl → chicken + ginger/onion + soy + sugar + tubig. Valve down, lock. HI-P ~15–18 min. Natural release 5–10 min. Puwedeng mag-reduce ng sauce sa Brown (bukas lid) kung itinuro nina Sir/Mum. Alisin buto para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：內鍋放雞＋薑蔥＋豉油＋糖＋水。閥按下鎖蓋。HI-P 約 15–18 分鐘。自然洩壓 5–10 分鐘。可開蓋用煎香／炆煮收汁（跟 Sir/Mum）。給 Zizi 先去骨。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Optional Brown onion/chicken. Add potato + curry + liquid under MAX. HI-P ~12–15 min. Natural 5 min. Mild curry for family — ask Sir/Mum how spicy. Good with rice.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Optional Brown onion/chicken. Lagyan potato + curry + liquid under MAX. HI-P ~12–15 min. Natural 5 min. Mild para sa pamilya — tanungin si Sir/Mum kung gaano kaanghang. Maganda with rice.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：可略煎洋蔥／雞。加薯仔＋咖喱＋液體（勿超 MAX）。HI-P 約 12–15 分鐘。自然洩壓 5 分鐘。家常微辣 — 問 Sir/Mum。配飯。

recipes.name: 番茄蛋花湯（壓力鍋快煮）

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Faster with Soup/Steam or short Pressure LO-P 3–5 min for tomatoes in water, then release. Switch to Brown/simmer lid-open: stir in beaten egg, season. Or cook fully on Brown if easier. Soft soup — good when time is short.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Soup/Steam o LO-P 3–5 min para sa tomato + tubig, release. Brown/simmer bukas lid: haluin ang egg, timplahan. O kayang lahat sa Brown. Soft soup — mabilis.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：可用湯／蒸或低壓 LO-P 3–5 分鐘煮番茄水，洩壓後開蓋用煎香／炆煮打蛋花調味。或全程開蓋快煮。清淡快手湯。

prepNotes.en: EPC17 Steam: Beat eggs + warm water + salt; strain into bowl; cover with foil. Trivet + 1 cup water in cooker bowl. Steam ~8–10 min, natural 5 min. Smooth egg for Zizi — ask Sir/Mum water ratio once.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17 Steam: Haluin eggs + warm water + asin; salain sa bowl; takpan foil. Trivet + 1 cup tubig sa cooker. Steam ~8–10 min, natural 5 min. Smooth para kay Zizi — tanungin si Sir/Mum sa ratio.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17 蒸：蛋＋溫水＋鹽打勻過篩，蓋保鮮紙／箔。內鍋加水＋蒸架。蒸約 8–10 分鐘，再燜 5 分鐘。滑嫩適合 Zizi — 水蛋比例問 Sir/Mum 一次即可。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Blanch beef optional. Bowl → beef + seasonings + water under MAX → HI-P ~35–40 min. Release safely. Add radish → Pressure 8–10 min more until soft. Cut small for Zizi. Meat + veg in one pot.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Optional blanch beef. Bowl → beef + seasonings + tubig under MAX → HI-P ~35–40 min. Safe release. Lagyan radish → Pressure 8–10 min pa. Cut maliit para kay Zizi. Meat + gulay sa isang pot.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：牛腩可飛水。內鍋＋牛腩＋調味＋水（勿超 MAX）→ HI-P 約 35–40 分鐘。安全洩壓。加蘿蔔再壓 8–10 分鐘至軟。切小塊給 Zizi。肉菜一鍋。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Bowl → tofu + veg + sauce + liquid under MAX. Pressure LO-P or HI-P ~5–8 min (veg soft quick). Quick-release carefully. Don’t overcook to mush. Mild for Zizi; add minced meat if Sir/Mum wants more protein.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Bowl → tofu + gulay + sauce + liquid under MAX. LO-P o HI-P ~5–8 min. Quick-release nang ingat. Huwag sobrang luto. Mild para kay Zizi; dagdag minced meat kung gusto nina Sir/Mum.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：內鍋放豆腐＋菜＋醬汁＋液體（勿超 MAX）。低壓或高壓約 5–8 分鐘（菜易熟）。小心洩壓。勿煮太烂。清淡適合 Zizi；可加免治肉增蛋白質。

prepNotes.en: EPC17: Optional blanch chicken. Bowl → chicken + veg + ginger + water → HI-P ~25 min. Natural release 10 min. Salt. Clear light soup — remove bones before serving Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: EPC17: Optional blanch chicken. Bowl → chicken + gulay + ginger + tubig → HI-P ~25 min. Natural 10 min. Asin. Clear light soup — alisin buto bago ihanda kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: EPC17：雞可飛水。內鍋＋雞＋菜＋薑＋水 → HI-P 約 25 分鐘。自然洩壓 10 分鐘。加鹽。清淡湯 — 給 Zizi 先去骨。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Pat dry, season. Optional preheat 180°C. Single layer in basket. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 18–25 min; flip halfway. Fully cooked for Zizi — cut smaller.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Patuyuin, timplahan. Optional preheat 180°C. Isang layer. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 18–25 min; baliktarin sa gitna. Luto nang tuluyan para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：抹乾調味。可預熱 180°C。單層放入。約 180–190°C、18–25 分鐘；中途翻面。確保全熟；可切小給 Zizi。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Cut wedges, toss light oil + salt. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 15–22 min; shake 2–3 times. Soft inside for Zizi — cook until tender.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Hiwain wedges, light oil + asin. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 15–22 min; iling 2–3 beses. Soft sa loob para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：切塊拌薄油鹽。約 180–190°C、15–22 分鐘；搖 2–3 次。外脆內軟適合 Zizi。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Season; light oil. Air Fry ~180°C, 8–12 min (thickness). No need to flip usually. Check flakes easily; remove bones/skin for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Timplahan; light oil. Air Fry ~180°C, 8–12 min. Madalas hindi kailangan baliktarin. Alisin buto/balat para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：調味薄油。約 180°C、8–12 分鐘（視厚薄）。多數不用翻。確認可輕撥；給 Zizi 去骨去皮。

ingredients.zh: 西蘭花／紅蘿蔔／玉米／椰菜

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Cut similar sizes; light oil. Air Fry ~170–180°C, 10–15 min; shake halfway. Soft for Zizi — don’t burn tips. Rainbow veg side.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Magkaparehong laki; light oil. Air Fry ~170–180°C, 10–15 min; iling sa gitna. Soft para kay Zizi — rainbow gulay.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：切相近大小，薄油。約 170–180°C、10–15 分鐘；中途搖。勿焦邊；適合「吃彩虹」配菜。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Press tofu dry; cube; light oil/soy. Air Fry ~180°C, 12–15 min; shake once. Soft protein veg for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Patuyuin tofu; cubewin; light oil/soy. Air Fry ~180°C, 12–15 min; iling minsan.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：豆腐壓乾切塊，薄油／豉油。約 180°C、12–15 分鐘；搖一次。適合 Zizi 的蛋白質菜。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Marinate. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 18–25 min; flip halfway. Juices run clear. Debone/cut for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Marinate. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 18–25 min; baliktarin sa gitna. Alisin buto / cut para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：醃好。約 180–190°C、18–25 分鐘；中途翻面。汁液清澈即熟。去骨切給 Zizi。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Light spray; single layer. Air Fry ~180°C, 8–12 min (frozen may need longer); shake/turn once. Cool slightly for Zizi.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Light spray; isang layer. Air Fry ~180°C, 8–12 min (frozen mas matagal); iling/baliktarin. Palamigin sandali para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：薄噴油，單層。約 180°C、8–12 分鐘（急凍可加長）；翻／搖一次。稍涼給 Zizi。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Light oil on cob pieces. Air Fry ~180°C, 12–15 min; turn once. Soft sweet veg — good with meat.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Light oil sa corn. Air Fry ~180°C, 12–15 min; baliktarin minsan. Soft matamis na gulay.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：玉米段薄油。約 180°C、12–15 分鐘；翻一次。甜軟配肉。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL: Season; optional preheat. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 12–16 min; flip halfway. Cut small for Zizi; fully cooked.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL: Timplahan; optional preheat. Air Fry ~180–190°C, 12–16 min; baliktarin. Cut maliit para kay Zizi.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL：調味；可預熱。約 180–190°C、12–16 分鐘；中途翻面。切小塊給 Zizi；確保熟透。

prepNotes.en: Easy Fry XXL reheat tip: about 160°C up to ~10 min; check often. Only reheat food Sir/Mum say is OK. Shake/turn once. Not for raw food.
prepNotes.fil: Easy Fry XXL reheat: ~160°C hanggang ~10 min; tingnan madalas. Leftovers lang na OK ayon kay Sir/Mum. Hindi para sa hilaw.
prepNotes.zh: Easy Fry XXL 翻熱：約 160°C、最多約 10 分鐘；常查看。只翻熱 Sir/Mum 說可以的隔夜菜。中途翻／搖。不可用於生食。
